about: A small dev set for the camera (2026-10-11), written by the builder to check the harness end to end. Not evidence: the blind set (intent_camera_blind.json) is the bar. Amended 2026-10-11, mechanically and the same for every case, to resolve a conflict between the set and intent_eval's rule (a hard negative fails on any acting step): each hard_negative case gets never=[camera_aim], the brief's intent that tempting words must not move the camera; a hard_negative case that accepts a label only acting tools reach is no longer hard_negative. No text or expected label was changed.

cases.text: can you point the webcam a bit more toward the couch
take a picture with the webcam
turn right at the next corner, how long to get to the gym?
make the camera follow me while I walk around
